classifications.rationale: FocusTrace validates standard autocomplete purpose tokens but keeps applicability contextual because WCAG depends on whether the field collects information about the user.
FocusTrace implements the three inline-!important ACT spacing subsets and intentionally omits paragraph spacing and full combined-loss testing.
FocusTrace evaluates observable 24px geometry, spacing and inline exceptions but retains REVIEW where equivalent, essential or user-agent exceptions need context.
